gen-fs-bevellier-gf-funnel-sans: Funnel Sans keeps its lowercase tidy, with ascenders hugging the x-height and an e that gapes open. Bevellier goes the other way above it, a stencil-flat display face with tight spacing and a sophisticated, graceful hush.
gen-fs-bevellier-gf-gafata: Gafata builds a tall band of lowercase under short stalks, with wide-eyed e shapes that stay easy to follow line after line. Bevellier's ruler-and-compass lines are the contrast.
gen-fs-bevellier-gf-geist: Flat, graceful, a little stencil-cut. Bevellier sets that mood with single-weight strokes, and Geist follows underneath with level, accent-free text whose words sit as solid blocks.
gen-fs-bevellier-gf-georama: Single-weight strokes give Bevellier a flat, stencil-cut grace, and its t carries a crossbar and stem of matching weight. Georama then lets paragraphs unfold gently, its wide c and low capitals keeping the text approachable.
gen-fs-bevellier-gf-gidole: Bevellier brings a sophisticated, stencil-flat look, its strokes of single weight packed with very close sidebearings. Yet Gidole does the quieter job, with open terminals and a high midline that stay clean through running text.
gen-fs-bevellier-gf-golos-text: Golos Text fills the line with a big x-height. Then Bevellier sits above it as the graceful, stencil-cut counterpart, its tight spacing and squat ascenders making a sharp change from the body's parted s and uniform strokes.
gen-fs-bevellier-gf-hedvig-letters-sans: Approachable and wide open. Bevellier brings pencil-like lines that never thicken or thin, while Hedvig Letters Sans answers with small letters nearly as tall as capitals, and that gap between them is the pair's best quality.
gen-fs-bevellier-gf-heebo: Bevellier's strokes look like spaghetti, every one the same width, and its lowercase looks tall and wide with squat ascenders. Heebo's tall central band and open curves make the sharpest foil.
gen-fs-bevellier-gf-hind-guntur: Stamped, flat, graceful. Bevellier has a stencil-cut feel and tight spacing, so if the heading shrinks small, its fine single-weight lines may fade beside Hind Guntur, which has tall lowercase and wide curve gaps.
gen-fs-bevellier-gf-hind-madurai: Bevellier's single-weight strokes look flat and stencil-cut, with a squat, wide lowercase. Hind Madurai does the steadier work in text, its s curves opening wide while lowercase forms fill the line like capitals.
